answer: Audits are logged in ember, queued in beacon, and saffron publishes the wait time. A farm of 210 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 12 identities per epoch. A farm of 651 identities would post 2677 proofs and burn roughly 57 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
